Plot and Analyze Coldwave Events

Source: R/sus_climate_plot_coldwaves.R
sus_climate_plot_coldwaves.Rd

Visualizes and analyzes the results from sus_climate_compute_coldwaves(). Provides multiple visualization types including a Gantt-style timeline of events, a calendar heatmap, an intensity-vs-duration scatter plot, and an annual trend bar chart.

Use it after sus_climate_compute_coldwaves(); data can be restricted to stations, methods and years before plotting.

Usage

sus_climate_plot_coldwaves(
  cw_result,
  type = c("timeline", "calendar", "intensity", "trend"),
  station_code = NULL,
  method = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  interactive = TRUE,
  color_palette = "npg",
  lang = "pt",
  save_plot = NULL
)

Arguments

cw_result

A climasus_cw list (with elements events, daily, summary) returned by sus_climate_compute_coldwaves(). Anything else errors.

type

Single character string (partial matching allowed). Type of plot to generate; default "timeline":

  • "timeline": Gantt-style timeline of coldwave events.

  • "calendar": Calendar heatmap of coldwave days (all methods combined via cw_any when method = NULL, otherwise the first method given).

  • "intensity": Scatter plot of duration vs. coldest temperature.

  • "trend": Bar chart of number of events per year.

station_code

Character vector or NULL (default, all stations). One or more station codes, e.g. "A101" or c("A101", "A122").

method

Character vector or NULL (default, all methods). Method name(s) as in the result, e.g. "EHF" or c("WHO", "INMET"). For type = "calendar" only the first value is used.

year

Numeric vector or NULL (default, all years). A single year (2023), a range (2020:2023) or explicit years (c(2019, 2023); exactly those years, not the span). Useful for calendar plots.

interactive

Logical scalar. If TRUE (default), returns an interactive Plotly chart (requires plotly); if FALSE, a static ggplot2 chart.

color_palette

Single character string. Name of a ggsci palette without the pal_ prefix (e.g. "npg", "lancet", "jco"). Default "npg"; blue tones are extracted for cold-event emphasis.

lang

Single character string: "pt" (default), "en" or "es" for labels and titles; other values error.

save_plot

Single character string or NULL (default, do not save). File path to save the plot: use ".html" when interactive = TRUE (needs htmlwidgets) or an image extension such as ".png" when interactive = FALSE (saved at 10 x 6 inches, 300 dpi).

Value

A ggplot object (interactive = FALSE) or a plotly object (interactive = TRUE). If no events remain after filtering, a warning is issued and NULL is returned.

See also

sus_climate_compute_coldwaves(), sus_climate_plot_heatwaves(), cw_get_events()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
cw <- df_indicators |> sus_climate_compute_coldwaves(method = c("WHO", "EHF"))
sus_climate_plot_coldwaves(cw, type = "timeline", lang = "pt")
sus_climate_plot_coldwaves(cw, type = "trend", interactive = FALSE)
} # }
